title: Resolve the same Item evidence from companion and in-repository layouts
preconditions: Use portable Saga with ready-check Item pinned to HEAD:app.go#L3 in its canonical source checkout.

steps.action: While the Saga is outside the source checkout, query slide-diffs with --repo pointing to source.
Move the Saga into its source checkout and repeat the same query without --repo.
steps.expected_result: Resolved output equals the companion output, reports current evidence and app.go.

expected_result: Resolved output equals the companion output, reports current evidence and app.go.
